objective: Consolidate owner-authorized existing-APK 2.0.6 Godot content and compatible source changes for Android staging; no production, new native APK or shared backend mutations.
productionBaselineEvidence: MAIN 9aed7d6ad8b6d0ad80aa71daaf66962e9d49de04 audited in fe3c4e5d19e2161531a980cfc1f51491ee19866a; compare from 206 public content shows only three runtime source paths differ; port all three, combining latest-message and global call ownership in ConnectThread by one exact hunk. No production release markers, migrations or Edge functions copied.
chosenApproach: Use the existing signed 2.0.6 Android bridge f1bca8319113402caffe99bd78c7ed0e963f963f; base verified public 3D content branch 0ddcad334a1facabb10aa9913a86e3dee0421224; overlay nonoverlapping source/test changes from 205 safe intake; retain native identity and public licensed asset provenance. Port Connect inbox and shared GIF using exact-context hunks; preserve Genesis video and picker logic; import micro motion with minimal layout insertion; use read-only staging points guard rather than overwrite Genesis Points UI.
selectionRationale: Existing 2.0.6 native bridge enables Godot content OTA; original signed Android artifact is verified in GitHub build 45168699649. Distinct Expo-free app is not compatible and needs independent local native completion.
alternativeApproaches: No full native migration via OTA.
No new isolated backend project or shared live database write.
No unlicensed private vendor assets or misleading premium gameplay claim.
preserveBehaviors: Retain existing 2.0.6 signed native module, app identity, channel, package and Godot 4.7.2.
Keep existing privacy/media scope, video preview metadata, no false call delivery, measured latest scroll, existing ad/navigation gates and lesson checker validation.
Game remains local practice and cosmetic-only; never credit live BP, shards, rank or property.
Connect inbox newest-first and notification ownership, searchable GIF picker with Genesis photo/video preservation, bounded micro-motion with reduced-motion guard, staging Points read-only.
acceptanceChecks: Exact source and native diff, full TypeScript/Metro, focused Node and ad/navigation gates.
Build and verify public-only Godot ZIP, checksum/manifest and real headless Godot tests; private FX and raw assets excluded.
Verify remote staging channel/branch/runtime/project, signed build proof and production mapping unchanged before authorized OTA; no production publish.
Physical device checks waived, recorded as NOT_PERFORMED.
